link_check_notes: Pexels photo pages answer 403 to curl but open in a browser and were read with WebFetch on 2026-10-16; the image CDN (images.pexels.com) answers 200. Unsplash was tried (two suitable photos found, 'A plumber repairs plumbing in a bathroom' by bhagya laxmi and 'person opening faucet' by Jacek Dylag) but Unsplash's bot check blocked every download route, so no Unsplash file is used. Two Wikimedia Commons photos were downloaded and rejected on quality (a 2006 US kitchen and a Finnish lake map on a phone); they are not in assets.
